name: com.faolline.graphimport
description: Generates com.faolline.graphdialoguesystem dialogue and speaker assets from a dedicated dialogue interchange JSON format, through a pure plan-then-apply pipeline. No source shape or column naming is assumed; only the pivot's own domain model (dialogue/line/choice/end/sub-dialogue) is opinionated.

samples.description: A worked two-dialogue interchange JSON (a choice, a sub-dialogue link, both end reasons) to try the import pipeline against your own project.
